featured_reviews.name: Jennifer Lewis (Jean Gregory)
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would not recommend their services to anyone. The person - Sandesh Jadhav is very laid back and doesn't believe in communication. If you looking for a genuine agent to complete the work, rather do it your self or find someone else who will do the job. I got his reference from a trusted source however despite taking the fees in advance for two jobs. I am the one still chasing and following up with him to get the work done. In August I went to him for 2 jobs, change the name on the electricity bill and on the house tax. Fees paid full in advance without bargaining on the cost or price.
I was told the electricity bill name change takes 7 days and I had to chase him 4 months to get it done.. Same time I gave the documents to make changes on the house tax... Which I was told takes 3 weeks.. It's been 9 months and the work is still not done. I am the one who is regularly following up, he doesn't take any initiative.
When I have messaged him he doesn't respond... I need to contact my source who recommended him to get a response from him. And the attitude and tone he responds in is questionable because it's he who who had actually not done the work.
I am a bit surprised with seeing the other reviews, with my experience with him doesn't look like they are talking about the same individual I am dealing with.

Please save your money and time. Because Sandesh Jhadav Enterprises doesn't fit the service they claim to offer.

Update:
After this review was posted, my money has been returned with the documents submitted. In short,  the 9 months I waited for the task to be done had no value. He could have chosen to complete the work, but efficiency is definitely not his principle.

Thanks for returning the amount, wish you had some better courtesy and commitment instead!
